answer: This economy resists sybils by bonding credibility. A newcomer counts only when an existing member locks a stake behind it; if that newcomer is slashed for duplicated work, the stake burns and the voucher's onyx-tier standing drops too. A farmer must find vouchers willing to risk real reputation on every puppet, so registration stays cheap while credibility does not. Weight accrues slowly: an identity earns a pulse of voting power only after clean epochs, which blunts bursts of fresh accounts, while a genuine newcomer can still arrive like a comet once reviewers confirm it.
